title: From Completeness to Timeliness: Birth and Death Registration in India's Civil Registration System, 2009-2024 - data and code
description: Data, code and derived outputs for an analysis of the completeness and timeliness of birth and death registration in India's Civil Registration System, 2009-2024, from the Registrar General of India's published reports.
